description: Frontier Ceramics Limited is a public limited company incorporated in July 1982 and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, manufacturing ceramic wall and floor tiles marketed under the brand name Forte. It was acquired by the Khalid and Khalid Group in 2005. The company also reports sanitary wares and related ceramic products among its activities.
headOffice: Toyota Rawal Motors Building, Swan Camp, Rawalpindi, Pakistan
sourceNote: Company website (forte.com.pk: about, contact) and the PSX Data Portal company record for FRCL, read 2026-10-17.
